name: Local city email newsletter
one_liner: A local news and events email newsletter for one city or town, paid for by local businesses who advertise in it.
customer: Local businesses (restaurants, events, services) buying ad slots
offer: Sponsored placements in the newsletter, plus sponsored social posts
how_it_makes_money: Ad sales. The case study made $144k/year from newsletter ads and charged $2,800 for one Instagram post
time_to_first_revenue: unknown; months, because you have to build the audience first
evidence: '$144,000 a year in revenue just on our newsletter ad' (xc2IjVqVdQY)
'Instagram. It's 2800 for one post' (xc2IjVqVdQY)
'You can easily run this whole business on 15 hours a week' (xc2IjVqVdQY)
Jazz in Canada turned it into a profitable six-figure business within a year (xc2IjVqVdQY)
risks: Selling ads to local businesses may need some calls
You need a city with enough local advertisers

name: Niche life-event ebook with upsell funnel
one_liner: A paid ebook or toolkit for a stressful life event (e.g. divorce or wedding planning), sold through paid ads and a funnel with order bumps.
customer: Consumers going through the life event
offer: A $29 ebook plus a $17 order-bump toolkit (e.g. a negotiation training toolkit) and further upsells
how_it_makes_money: Direct digital sales. Upsells and bump offers raise the average order value above the ad cost per purchase
startup_cost: low (ad testing budget plus a funnel tool subscription)
time_to_first_revenue: days to weeks; about $400 in sales came in during the first ad test
evidence: 'priced the book at 29 for an ebook' (wD-PkHYxsgY)
'selling this thing for 29 bucks it's costing me 40 bucks to get that purchase' (wD-PkHYxsgY)
'launched the negotiation training toolkit, $17 bump offer' (wD-PkHYxsgY)
'I made money selling a divorce product' (wD-PkHYxsgY)
risks: The first test lost money: $40 to acquire each $29 sale
Depends on paid ads and rising ad costs
Crowded market (Etsy has millions of wedding templates)

name: Foreign-language content republishing for a revenue share
one_liner: Translate existing creators' content into other languages and publish it on Facebook, splitting the creator payouts 50/50.
customer: Content creators who want income in new language markets (revenue comes from Facebook creator payouts)
offer: Translation, dubbing and publishing of their content in another language
how_it_makes_money: A 50/50 split of Facebook creator payouts (about $0.20 per 1,000 views was mentioned)
evidence: 'facebook is paying creators like me 20 cents per thousand views' (xA1crdAIneU)
'publish it for you in a foreign language and I'm going to put the revenue 50/50 you need a $50 a month account' (xA1crdAIneU)
risks: Evidence is weak: this was a brainstormed idea
The payout rate per view is low, so you need very large view counts
Facebook monetization eligibility and policy risk

name: Parking lot line striping and seal coating
one_liner: A local service that re-stripes and seal-coats parking lots for commercial property owners.
customer: Commercial property owners and managers, businesses, churches
offer: Parking lot line striping and asphalt seal coating
how_it_makes_money: Per-job pricing. Month one was 4 jobs for $22,874; month two was 7 jobs for $46,825
startup_cost: low-medium (amount not stated; started with a minivan)
evidence: 'First month I had four jobs and my revenue was 22,874' (vF7IT30L4jY)
'I had seven jobs and my revenue was 46,825' (vF7IT30L4jY)
Hunter had no industry experience; Sinko in Waco ran a similar business (vF7IT30L4jY)
risks: Depends on the weather and season

name: Bounce house / inflatable rentals
one_liner: Rent inflatables and obstacle courses for parties and events, booked through Facebook Marketplace and a website.
offer: Delivery, setup and pickup of inflatables, plus chairs and tables
how_it_makes_money: Per-rental fees. Started with 2 used units at $400 each and grew to 40+. The video claims a $1,600 unit can make $1,600/month profit
evidence: 'started with two inflatables in your garage... 400 each and they were used' (yTc3M4oMdnQ)
'we have now about over 40 inflatables' (yTc3M4oMdnQ)
Owner says competition has increased since COVID (yTc3M4oMdnQ)
risks: Heavy units (80-250 lbs) and weekend labour
The $1,600/month profit claim is the host's hype

name: Inflatable repair and manufacturing for rental operators
one_liner: Sell repairs and new or custom inflatables to other bounce house rental companies.
how_it_makes_money: Repair fees and unit sales; more competitors means more customers
evidence: Made about 15 of their 40 units themselves (yTc3M4oMdnQ)
'not that many' competitors do their own repairs or manufacturing (yTc3M4oMdnQ)

name: Mobile car detailing
one_liner: An on-site car detailing service aimed at owners of well-kept cars, growing through referrals and recurring monthly visits.
customer: Owners of well-kept or higher-end cars
offer: Mobile detailing and monthly maintenance details
how_it_makes_money: Per-detail pricing (about $100 for the first job) plus recurring monthly customers and referrals
evidence: 'I charged $100 cuz her car was fairly clean' (xGf27oVmgYE)
Left business cards on nicer cars; one client brought high-profile referrals (xGf27oVmgYE)

name: Vintage photo booth placement in bars
one_liner: Buy old-style photo booths from China and place them in bars to earn per-use revenue.
customer: Bar patrons, with revenue shared with the bar owner
how_it_makes_money: Per-use fees, presumably split with the venue
evidence: 'old timey photo booths you just freaking get bar owner on the phone buy them from China and you place it' (xA1crdAIneU), a brainstorm mention, so evidence is weak
